## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 25, 2026 - Aug 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Chris_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "The only unique part of the app (the ranking) is behind a paywall. Not only does this diminish the purpose and the USP of the app, but this will essentially make all free users disincentivised, leading to a poorer "ranking" system even if the app uses the full dataset. Good idea but poor monetisation methodology imo"
            2. _Ruben Anderson_, Aug 25, 2026, 1/5: "this app has a horrible subscription system. they advertise a "Free 1 week trial period" and as soon as you cross into the 8th day the automatically charge you 80,00€ for the entire year. No monthly subscription or anything, immediate 12 month charge right away. Then when you go to cancel the subscription, there will be no refunds instead youre just stuck with the membership untill those 12 months run out. Super devious work."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 18, 2026 - Aug 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Paul Lapouge Dalbavie_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Application beaucoup trop cher qui vous propose un premier mois a 6€ mais au suivant quelle fut ma surprise de me rendre compte que l'abonnement mensuel été ensuite a plus de 70€, bien sûr si je n'avais pas regardé en détail sur le Play Store il est impossible de le savoir Malgré que ce soit une bonne application malgré les bugs récurent, elle est beaucoup trop cher pour ce que c'est"
            2. _Mc Marcuzz_, Aug 21, 2026, 2/5: "2/5 la app. la estoy usando hace más de dos meses. no sé entiende muy bien el sistema de rangos, no subís nunca, es como si te invitará a pagar la aplicación para que puedas subir. mala experiencia, muchos Bugs, las ventanas de la app cuando tocas para agregar series, en 8 de cada 10 veces, se solapa y no te deja ver nada. a veces no responden las funciones. tiene potencial, pero voy a desistir el uso."
            3. _zakariyya Bhana_, Aug 19, 2026, 5/5: "Can't say otherwise than its a great app with developers who are eager to keep updating and striving to make the app better for its users. To my shock, they also deeply connect with its users and respond very quickly and swiftly compensate if there has been any issues. Best gym app ever and I know it will only get better."
<!--/ir-theme-->
